# Unbanz

> Unbanz (unbanz.com) is a service that recovers banned Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat accounts, handles account bans/takedowns and username claims. It also fixes restricted Meta ad accounts. Unbanz is a brand name (also "Unbanz HQ"), not a misspelling of "unban". Independent service. Not affiliated with Meta.

Key facts:

- Website: https://unbanz.com. WhatsApp: +1 934 201 2490 (https://wa.me/19342012490). Email: team@unbanz.com. Instagram and X: @unbanzhq.
- Unbans: banned, disabled, suspended or hacked Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat accounts.
- Bans: fake, impersonation, scam and harassing accounts taken down on Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat.
- Username claims (main service): inactive, taken and OG handles on Instagram, Facebook (profiles and Page names) and Snapchat. The handle goes on the client's own profile; no accounts are bought or sold; the client gets a price before work starts. Pages: https://unbanz.com/username/ , /inactive-instagram-username/ , /taken-instagram-username/ , /og-username/ , /facebook-username-claim/ , /username-claim-pricing/ , /is-a-username-claim-safe/
- Ad accounts: restricted Meta ad accounts and Business Portfolios.
- Process: send the username and a screenshot of the notice, get your price, say go. Usual estimate 3–14 days from the day work starts.
- Pricing: depends on the account and the issue. You get a price before any work starts. Scope, payment terms and any refund terms are agreed in the chat before work starts.
- Guarantee: "Guaranteed. If we take it on, we get it done."
- Safety: Unbanz works from the username and the notice. Your password and login codes stay with you.
- Proof: real takedown screenshots (names hidden) at https://unbanz.com/work/.
- Focus: Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat and Meta ad accounts.
